name: inout
description: INOUT — Control de asistencia y liquidación de horas extras (Colombia)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @inout/api" "npm run dev -w @inout/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @inout/web && npm run build -w @inout/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @inout/core && npm run test -w @inout/api
